0.a: Approximately three hours, including sightseeing and photo stops.

1.a: Choose a shared tour to meet other travellers, a private city tour for the main highlights exclusively with your group, or a private Islamic architecture tour to explore Valencia’s Islamic past and architectural heritage.

2.q: Can I book a shared tour for one or two people?
2.a: You can book for one or two people. Each shared departure requires 3 participants in total; separate bookings count. If the minimum is not reached, we offer another available departure or a full refund. You can also ask about upgrading to a private tour.

3.q: Which languages are available for shared tours?

4.q: Is there language exchange on shared tours?
4.a: Explore Valencia together on a three-hour guided ride. Meet travellers from different countries, share stories and practise languages informally. Your guide’s commentary is in the language selected for your departure.

5.q: Can I book a private tour for one person?
5.a: Yes. Either private tour costs €225 for one person. For up to 10 people in your booking, the total remains €225, shared between participants. Larger groups require a quotation.

6.q: What time can a private tour start?
6.a: Private tours start every 30 minutes from 10:00 to 16:00, subject to guide and bike availability. Book at least 24 hours in advance. Duration: 3 hours. All times are local to Valencia (Europe/Madrid).

7.q: Which languages are available for the Private City Bike Tour?

getting-around-valencia-by-bike.title: Getting Around Valencia by Bike: A Practical Guide | Bike Tour VLC
getting-around-valencia-by-bike.metaDescription: Why Valencia is one of Spain's easiest cities to cycle: the Turia Gardens, flat terrain and a growing bike-lane network. A practical guide for visitors.
getting-around-valencia-by-bike.heading: Getting around Valencia by bike
body: Valencia is unusually kind to cyclists. The city sits on flat coastal plain, and its best-known cycling asset is the Jardí del Túria — roughly nine kilometres of gardens created in the former riverbed after the river was diverted following the 1957 flood. The park crosses the city from west to east and lets you ride from the Bioparc area to the City of Arts and Sciences almost without touching traffic.

Beyond the Turia, Valencia has been expanding its network of protected bike lanes across the centre and toward the beach neighbourhoods of Malvarrosa and El Cabanyal. The historic centre itself is largely calm, with many pedestrianised or low-traffic streets.

Practical notes: bikes are common and drivers are used to them, but the usual city caution applies at junctions. Valenbisi, the city's public bike-share, is aimed at residents and short trips; visitors staying several days can also rent from local shops. Summer midday heat is real — ride in the morning or late afternoon, and carry water.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Bike Tour VLC
privacy.metaDescription: How Bike Tour VLC handles personal data from booking requests and contact messages.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy

data.title: What we collect
data.text: When you send a booking request or contact message we store the details you provide: name, email, optional phone number, group size, preferred date and language, and your message. We use this only to answer you and organise your tour. Payments are processed by Stripe. We send Stripe your email, selected tour, date and reservation amount, and store the payment reference and status. Card details are entered on Stripe and are not stored by this website.

use.title: How we use it
use.text: Your data is used to respond to your request, confirm availability and pricing, and manage the tour. We do not sell data, we do not send marketing email without your consent, and we do not send your personal form data to analytics tools. We use Resend to send reservation payment acknowledgements, operator notifications and contact-form messages. Email content and recipient addresses are processed by Resend for delivery.

retention.title: Storage and retention
retention.text: Booking requests are stored on our hosting provider's infrastructure within the EU/EEA or under appropriate safeguards. We keep requests as long as needed to handle your booking and meet legal obligations.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: Under the GDPR you can request access, correction or deletion of your personal data at any time via the contact page. You can also complain to the Spanish data protection authority (AEPD).

review.title: Status of this policy
review.text: This policy is a working draft prepared for launch. The operator's legal identity and final data-processing details must be confirmed before the site goes live.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy | Bike Tour VLC
cookies.metaDescription: Cookie policy for Bike Tour VLC: strictly necessary storage only, no tracking without consent.
cookies.heading: Cookie policy

necessary.title: What this site uses
necessary.text: This website works without tracking cookies. We use only technically necessary storage required to deliver the pages you request. During checkout, we save a reservation draft in your browser’s session storage so you can return after cancelling payment. It is removed after payment confirmation or when the browser session ends. Checkout also works if this storage is blocked, but draft recovery is then unavailable.

analytics.title: Analytics and consent
analytics.text: If we enable privacy-respecting analytics in the future, non-essential measurement will only run after you give consent, and you will be able to change your choice. Personal form data is never sent to analytics.

manage.title: Managing cookies
manage.text: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings at any time without affecting the booking request form.
